decisions.reason: The daily research quantity does not change the Shopify listing rule; the requirement already applies to selected products without storing a separate quantity.
The TikTok requirement already covers all selected products, so setting the research target to 20 products per day does not modify its listing rules.
The product count does not change the spreadsheet's structure or concurrent recording rule.
A same-message MODIFY already records the daily dropshipping product target as 20, and no additional update or removal is required.
The CJ Dropshipping daily product target does not affect the Airbnb lead follow-up workflow.
The source sets a dropshipping product-research quantity and does not alter the daily Airbnb outreach cadence.
The numerical product target does not change the fallback rule for independently selecting other available work.
The daily product target does not change artifact storage, document destination, or supporting-link requirements.
The CJ Dropshipping product quantity is unrelated to the spreadsheet workflow for interested Airbnb leads.
